coder_notes: Randomised phase Ib across four experimental cohorts, no control arm. ABBV-637 and ABBV-155 are paired with ERAS-801 in the recurrent cohorts (A, B) and given on a temozolomide + radiotherapy backbone alone in the newly diagnosed cohorts (C, D); coded experimental_combination because of the pairing with ERAS-801 in A/B; role would be experimental_monotherapy in C/D. EGFR amplification is a whole-trial entry requirement; matched to ERAS-801 (EGFR inhibitor, hint from outside knowledge of the drug) and likely also relevant to the ABBV agents. The record plans on-treatment surgery in cohorts A/B but states no PK or PD outcome, so tumour PK and target engagement are coded no.
